package.name: unitree_g1_adapter
package.description: ROS-free Unitree G1 SDK adapter: a thin, injectable boundary over the official unitree_sdk2_python channels, IDL and RPC clients. It owns vendor import guarding, factory/channel lifecycle and vendor return-code mapping; it never re-implements the vendor RPC or DDS protocol and it carries no robot-specific joint mapping or control policy (AtomGit Issue #171).
